description.km: មិនថាអ្នករស់នៅបន្ទប់ជួលម្នាក់ឯង ជាបុគ្គលិកការិយាល័យរវល់ ឬជាមេផ្ទះដែលចង់បានភាពងាយស្រួល Ingredient ត្រូវបានរចនាឡើងដើម្បីអ្នក!
description.en: Whether you're a student living in an apartment, a busy professional, or a homemaker managing family meals, Ingredient fits seamlessly into your daily routine.

personas.descKm: ចង់ចម្អិនម្ហូបញ៉ាំខ្លួនឯងដើម្បីសុខភាព និងសន្សំសំចៃ ប៉ុន្តែមិនចង់ទិញគ្រឿងច្រើនសល់ក្នុងបន្ទប់ជួល ឬមិនសូវចេះធ្វើម្ហូប។ ឈុត ២-៣ នាក់ រួមជាមួយវីដេអូបង្រៀន គឺជាដំណោះស្រាយល្អឥតខ្ចោះ!
personas.descEn: Want to cook healthy meals and save money, but have limited kitchen space and inexperience. Our 2-3 portion kits with step-by-step videos eliminate guesswork and waste.

checklist.km: ទំហំឈុតល្មមញ៉ាំ គ្មានសល់គ្រឿង

personas.descEn: Exhausted after long office hours, the last thing you want is market traffic or laborious food prep. Pre-order online and cook a nutritious dinner in just 15-20 minutes.

personas.descEn: Managing daily household meals is demanding. Our 4–5 person family packages provide convenient recipe variety, eliminate leftover food rot, and streamline monthly kitchen budgets.
